200.title: We’d be ‘stupid’ not to: Poland defends $300M military AI deal with Palantir
200.summary: News Defense We’d be ‘stupid’ not to: Poland defends $300M military AI deal with Palantir Poland’s defense minister said it would be “wrong” not to use the software, despite concerns over reliance on American technology.
200.body: News Defense We’d be ‘stupid’ not to: Poland defends $300M military AI deal with Palantir Poland’s defense minister said it would be “wrong” not to use the software, despite concerns over reliance on American technology. “It would be stupid and wrong not to use it,” Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz told reporters, crediting Palantir’s technology with helping Ukraine withstand more than four years of fighting Russia. Palantir celebrated the deal on X, calling Maven “the vanguard of next-generation AI warfare” and saying it was proud to stand with Poland in defending a “sovereign Europe.” The company, which has drawn criticism for its work with U.S. immigration authorities and the Israeli military, faced protests in Warsaw earlier this month over concerns about data security and technological independence.

400.summary: Brussels, 20 November 2026 On Friday, the European Commission partially greenlighted Poland’s sixth and final payment request for €12.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility , the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU. The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision .
400.body: Brussels, 20 November 2026 On Friday, the European Commission partially greenlighted Poland’s sixth and final payment request for €12.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility , the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU. The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision . The payment to Poland for the already greenlighted milestones and targets can take place following the EFC’s positive opinion and the subsequent adoption of a payment decision by the Commission. With a view to the closure of the Recovery and Resilience Facility at the end of 2026, Members States had to implement all outstanding milestones and targets by the end of August 2026 and submit final payment requests by the end of September 2026.

500.body: The parser is the piece that turns the model’s raw output into structured tool_calls . vLLM documents parsers for several formats, including Hermes-style and GLM-4, so pick the one your model card names. vllm serve YOUR_MODEL_ID --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser YOUR_PARSER_NAME Replace both placeholders with values from the model card. Keeping the agent package, tests, evals, and traces in separate folders pays off later, because each has a different lifecycle: code changes often, evals change rarely, and traces grow forever. mkdir open-agent && cd open-agent python3 -m venv .venv source .venv/bin/activate pip install openai jsonschema pytest mkdir -p agent tests evals workspace traces touch agent/__init__.py Now write the settings module.

600.body: Lech Poznań and Jagiellonia Białystok face an uphill battle to reach the knockouts Polish football endured a mixed night in the Europa League on Thursday as Lech Poznań and Jagiellonia Białystok dropped valuable points in their push for the knockout play-offs, while some Jagiellonia fans were thrown out of Sunderland’s Stadium of Light. Jagiellonia, from the north-eastern Polish city of Białystok, earned a 1-1 draw against English Premier League side Sunderland but remain 30th with four points. Despite the restriction, some Polish fans entered home sections at Sunderland’s Stadium of Light before being removed by stewards and police. When Sunderland fans saw the Polish supporter next to them, they called to the stewards and pointed to where he was sitting to get him out,” Journalist Szymon Janczyk told Polish sports website Meczyki.
